author: independent loop-1 critic pair, Spring Boot 4/Java 25 SME role (Claude subagent; did not author the blueprint), 2026-11-19; same agent as the education role, disclosed. Reviewed 2026-11-19 against blueprint 2cc0b89a, course.json, the seven module labs (lab.json), module S13 notes, the final-mcq blueprint, and the STANDARD_FAST_PROMPT/SITREP final-day model. Objectives: all 30 resolve to existing topic.json objectives and are taught; formats are practical; the file carries no item or key material (no answer leakage); Boot 4.1.2/Java 25/offline H2 statements agree with the labs and the MCQ blueprint. Terminal for this loop: findings recorded OPEN; no recheck performed.

findings.claim: Technical density: the 8 tasks must exercise Flyway migration, JPA entity/repository/@Query/pagination, DTO mapping, bidirectional relationship with JOIN FETCH, @Transactional, Bean Validation with @RestControllerAdvice and ProblemDetail, @MockitoBean/@WebMvcTest, a @SpringBootTest, RestClient with base URL and timeouts, bcrypt, JwtEncoder with resource-server validation and role rules tested with spring-security-test, all in one offline mvn -q -o test project. In the labs the security module alone is a 55-minute task block and validation/testing 67. Fitting these in 150 minutes means each task is a narrow gap-fill against a pre-built project; the blueprint does not say the project is a starter with most of the scaffolding present, so a candidate could read it as build-from-scratch.
findings.recommendation: State that the project is a provided starter where each task fills a bounded gap, and that no task requires configuring the JWT key pair or Flyway from nothing; or trim objectives (for example one of issuing/validating JWT) to match the time.

findings.claim: itemCounts.practical is exactly 8 but the prose says 'about 8 linked tasks', and 'items' of a hidden-test project are not countable units the way the MCQ items are.
findings.recommendation: Say 'exactly 8 tasks' or drop the count and state it as an owner-held scoring unit.

findings.claim: The only resource statement covers the machine and offline setup. It is silent on documentation, notes, internet and AI assistance ('needs no AI service' is a setup remark, not a rule), whereas the module check defers explicitly to the platform owner.
findings.recommendation: Add one clause deferring the open-book/AI rule to the platform assessment owner, as the module-check blueprint does.

findings.claim: Health-checks and logging topics are not sampled here (the MCQ blueprint explains their omission; this one does not). Coverage of the practical is otherwise one o1 per taught topic, which is appropriate for gradable coding objectives.
findings.recommendation: Optional: one sentence noting which taught topics are intentionally not exercised in the practical.
